findings.description: When the last attempt raises GatewayError, the code logs and executes `break`, so the loop exits and charge() falls off the end and returns None, even though it is annotated to return Charge. The error is swallowed. In settle_invoice, GatewayError is not raised, so the `except` branch is skipped. Execution continues to `invoice.status = PAID` and then `invoice.charge_id = charge.id`, which raises AttributeError on None. That exception escapes settle_open_invoices and aborts the whole batch. The invoice is left marked PAID with no charge_id, and the failed charge is never recorded as PAYMENT_FAILED. Every invoice whose charge fails after all retries triggers this.
findings.suggestion: Re-raise the last GatewayError instead of breaking, for example replace `break` with `raise`, so the caller sees the failure and settle_invoice records PAYMENT_FAILED as intended.
findings.title: Retry loop returns None after the final failed attempt instead of raising
